nom: DIME Hyper Glow Vitamin C Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily-leaning skin describes the serum as lightweight and not oily or greasy, giving a dewy rather than shiny finish.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum cleared winter dryness within days, left skin less dry over time, and one felt it was 'not drying' despite expecting it to be.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer says it manages oiliness with a lightweight, dewy look and has lightened acne scars.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, acne-prone or postpartum sensitive skin, report no burning or breakouts and good tolerance, though a few mention a slight sting or tingle and one reports the product broke her skin out and burned.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older (50s) or 'mature' report firmer, more supple skin, softened fine lines, and a youthful glow with continued use.
segments.normal: General reviewers without a stated skin type mostly describe brighter, glowing, hydrated skin with a lightweight, non-greasy after-feel.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report firmer skin, fewer fine lines, and a more youthful look with regular use, often paired with other Dime products.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it hydrates, plumps and removes dryness within days; one dry-skin reviewer says it's 'not drying' and improves dry patches.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea and redness-prone sensitive skin says it eliminates redness without added sensitivity and is the only vitamin C serum she can tolerate.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report lightened melasma, dark spots, or age spots within one week to a few months; effects described as gradual and visible in comparison photos.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and fading acne scars; one reviewer reports the opposite, stating it broke her out and burned her skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the texture as non-oily, non-greasy and quickly absorbed, helping combination skin achieve a dewy rather than shiny finish.

aspects.libelle: Bottle leaks during travel or shipping
Mild stinging or tingling on application
Pills or flakes under some moisturizers

extraits.texte: I got this as a diamond gift .. and unfortunately it broke me out and burned my skin i dont recommend
I have sensitive skin and Rosacea. This is the first Vit C serum I can use that doesn't burn

I have used Hyper Glow for a few months now and I can definitely tell a difference when I'm not using it. My skin looks more pale and a little more dry. It's my go to for skin correcting, precious acne scars have lightened and it helps to manage my combo skin with a lightweight dewy look.

I absolutely love this serum. I have not found anything else that makes my skin feel such relief. I have dry and sensitive skin that gets easily red, this helps eliminate the redness without further sensitivity. My skin feels brighter and softer.

Cleared up my winter dry skin on my face in just a few days and it feels lovely dries like nothing' there. I was just using baby lotion on my face and for a long time that was fine but I could instantly tell this was better. So glad to have found it. I just use the serum and daily face cream after I shower at night.

Loving this DIME HYPER GLOW SERUM. I can already see a drastic lightening of my melisma spots on my cheeks after only one week of use. I'd like to buy a micro needling roller to use before applying so the product can get even deeper into my skin. Excited to see more results!
This is a must have/use when using the TBT crème. My skin is so much more firm with less fine lines since I started using the combo a couple of years ago
